                                                                                                                                                                                    सात वर्ष पूर्व, प्राची की आयु, अपनी पुत्री की आयु से चार गुना थी। अब से चार वर्ष बाद, प्राची की आयु, अपनी पुत्री की आयु से ढाई गुना होगी। प्राची और उसकी पुत्री की वर्तमान आयु (वर्षों में) का योग ज्ञात कीजिए।

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "69"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "77"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "49"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "72"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "pa": {"value": "ਸੱਤ ਸਾਲ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ, ਪ੍ਰਾਚੀ ਆਪਣੀ ਧੀ ਦੀ ਉਮਰ ਤੋਂ ਚਾਰ ਗੁਣਾ ਵੱਡੀ ਸੀ। ਹੁਣ ਤੋਂ ਚਾਰ ਸਾਲ ਬਾਅਦ, ਪ੍ਰਾਚੀ ਦੀ ਉਮਰ ਉਸਦੀ ਧੀ ਦੀ ਉਮਰ ਤੋਂ ਢਾਈ ਗੁਣਾ ਹੋਵੇਗੀ। ਪ੍ਰਾਚੀ ਅਤੇ ਉਸਦੀ ਧੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਉਮਰਾਂ (ਸਾਲਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ) ਦਾ ਜੋੜ ਪਤਾ ਕਰੋ।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "69"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "77"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "49"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "72"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    Ratio of ages (Prachi : Daughter) 7 years ago = 4 : 1 (Difference = 3 parts)

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    Ratio of ages 4 years from now = 2.5 : 1 = 5 : 2 (Difference = 3 parts)

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    Since differences are equal, 1 ratio part = Total time gap = 7 + 4 = 11 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    Sum of ages 7 years ago = 4 + 1 = 5 parts = 5 × 11 = 55 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    Sum of present ages = 55 + (7 × 2) = 69 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ The correct answer is 69 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    Let Prachi's present age be P and her daughter's present age be D.

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ Seven years ago: P − 7 = 4 × (D − 7)

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ P − 4D = −28 + 7

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ P − 4D = −21   --- (Equation 1)

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ Four years from now: P + 4 = 2.5 × (D + 4)

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ P − 2.5D = 10 − 4

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ P − 2.5D = 6   --- (Equation 2)

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ Subtracting Equation 1 from Equation 2:

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ (P − 2.5D) − (P − 4D) = 6 − (−21)

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 1.5D = 27

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ D = 18 years

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ Substitute D = 18 in Equation 1:

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ P − 4 × 18 = −21

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ P − 72 = −21 ⇒ P = 51 years

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ Sum of present ages = P + D = 51 + 18 = 69 years

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ The correct answer is 69 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    Constant Age Difference

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    The difference between the ages of two individuals remains constant at any point in time. This is a fundamental concept used to balance ratio parts in age-related problems.

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    Sum of Ages Shift

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    If the sum of present ages of n people is S, then t years ago, their sum was S − nt, and t years later, it will be S + nt.

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    Ratio Balancing Method

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                    If the difference between two quantities is unchanged, multiply the ratios by suitable integers to make the difference in ratio parts equal. Then each ratio part can be directly equated to the real-world value.

                                                                                                                                                                                    दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    सात वर्ष पूर्व, प्राची की आयु, अपनी पुत्री की आयु से चार गुना थी। 

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    अब से चार वर्ष बाद, प्राची की आयु, अपनी पुत्री की आयु से ढाई गुना होगी।

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    मान लीजिए प्राची की वर्तमान आयु P वर्ष है।

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    मान लीजिए उसकी पुत्री की वर्तमान आयु D वर्ष है।

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    सात वर्ष पहले, प्राची की आयु = P - 7

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    सात वर्ष पहले, पुत्री की आयु = D - 7

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    दिया गया है: P - 7 = 4(D - 7)

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    चार वर्ष बाद, प्राची की आयु = P + 4

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    चार वर्ष बाद, पुत्री की आयु = D + 4

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    दिया गया है: P + 4 = 2.5(D + 4)

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    पहले समीकरण से:

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ P - 7 = 4(D - 7)

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ P - 7 = 4D - 28

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ P = 4D - 21 (समीकरण 1)

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    दूसरे समीकरण से:

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ P + 4 = 2.5(D + 4)

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ P + 4 = 2.5D + 10

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ P = 2.5D + 6 (समीकरण 2)

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    समीकरण 1 और समीकरण 2 को बराबर करने पर:

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 4D - 21 = 2.5D + 6

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 4D - 2.5D = 6 + 21

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 1.5D = 27

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ D = 18

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    समीकरण 1 में D = 18 प्रतिस्थापित करने पर:

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ P = 4(18) - 21

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ P = 72 - 21

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ P = 51

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    प्राची और उसकी पुत्री की वर्तमान आयु का योग:

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ P + D = 51 + 18

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ P + D = 69

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    प्राची और उसकी पुत्री की वर्तमान आयु का योग 69 वर्ष है।

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    Shortcut Trick 

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n101:Tadd,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ:

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ਸੱਤ ਸਾਲ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ, ਪ੍ਰਾਚੀ ਆਪਣੀ ਧੀ ਦੀ ਉਸ ਸਮੇਂ ਦੀ ਉਮਰ ਤੋਂ ਚਾਰ ਗੁਣਾ ਵੱਡੀ ਸੀ।

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ਮੰਨ ਲਓ ਉਸਦੀ ਧੀ ਦੀ ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਉਮਰ D ਸਾਲ ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    ਸੱਤ ਸਾਲ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ, ਧੀ ਦੀ ਉਮਰ = D - 7

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

Find the area (in cm2) of this sector.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "86.525"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "86.625"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "86.875"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "86.125"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "15.75 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले एक वृत्त से 11 सेमी चाप लंबाई वाला एक त्रिज्यखंड काटा जाता है। इस त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल (सेमी2 में) ज्ञात कीजिए।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "86.525"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "86.625"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "86.875"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "86.125"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      When both the arc length and the radius of a sector are given, the area can be calculated directly without finding the central angle.

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Area = 1⁄2 × Arc Length × Radius

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Area = 1⁄2 × 11 × 15.75

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Area = 5.5 × 15.75 = 86.625 cm2

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is 86.625 cm2.

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Radius of the circle, r = 15.75 cm

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Arc length of the sector, l = 11 cm

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Area of a sector = 1⁄2 × l × r

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Area = 1⁄2 × 11 × 15.75

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Area = 5.5 × 15.75

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Area = 86.625 cm2

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is 86.625 cm2.

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Area of a Sector (When central angle is given)

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Area = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr2, where θ is the central angle.

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Arc Length (When central angle is given)

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Arc length (l) = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Perimeter of a Sector

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Perimeter = l + 2r (sum of the arc length and two radii)

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Area of a Segment of a Circle

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Area of Segment = Area of the Corresponding Sector − Area of the Triangle formed by the radii and the chord.

                                                                                                                                                                                      दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      वृत्त की त्रिज्या = 15.75 सेमी

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      त्रिज्यखंड की चाप लंबाई = 11 सेमी

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल = \\(\\frac{1}{2} \\times r \\times l\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      त्रिज्या (r) = 15.75 सेमी

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      चाप की लंबाई (l) = 11 सेमी

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ଗଣନା:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      \\(\\frac{(8.3)^3 + (9.2)^3 + (6.1)^3 - 3 × 8.3 × 9.2 × 6.1}{(8.3)^2 + (9.2)^2 + (6.1)^2 - 8.3 × 9.2 - 9.2 × 6.1 - 6.1 × 8.3}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ (8.3 + 9.2 + 6.1){(8.3)2 + (9.2)2 + (6.1)2 - 8.3 t) = \\(\\frac{1}{3}\\) है, तो sec(t) का मान कितना है?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "<span class="math-tex">\\( \\frac{2\\sqrt{2}}{3}\\)</span>"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span class="math-tex">\\(\\frac{\\sqrt{10}}{9}\\)</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span class="math-tex">\\(\\frac{\\sqrt{10}}{3}\\)</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span class="math-tex">\\(\\frac{\\sqrt{3}}{3}\\)</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Using the fundamental trigonometric identity: sec2(t) = 1 + tan2(t)

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ sec2(t) = 1 + (1 / 3)2 = 1 + 1 / 9 = 10 / 9

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ sec(t) = √(10 / 9) = √10 / 3

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is √10 / 3.

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      tan(t) = 1 / 3

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      tan(t) = Perpendicular / Base

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      sec(t) = Hypotenuse / Base

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Pythagoras Theorem: Hypotenuse2 = Perpendicular2 + Base2

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ By comparing the ratio, let Perpendicular = 1 and Base = 3

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Hypotenuse = √(12 + 32)

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Hypotenuse = √(1 + 9) = √10

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ sec(t) = Hypotenuse / Base

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ sec(t) = √10 / 3

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is √10 / 3.

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Trigonometric Identities

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      The three primary Pythagorean identities are: sin2θ + cos2θ = 1, sec2θ − tan2θ = 1, and cosec2θ − cot2θ = 1.

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Pythagoras Theorem

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      In a right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of its base and perpendicular: Hypotenuse2 = Base2 + Perpendicular2.

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Trigonometric Ratios

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      For an angle t in a right triangle: tan(t) = Perpendicular ÷ Base, cos(t) = Base ÷ Hypotenuse, and sec(t) is the reciprocal of cos(t) ⇒ Hypotenuse ÷ Base.

{"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Identify the given matching components between the two triangles directly.

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      We are given two equal sides (PQ = SR) and one common side (QR = RQ).

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      The angle exactly between these sides is given as equal (∠PQR = ∠SRQ = 90°).

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Since the equal angle is perfectly included between the equal sides, the SAS (Side-Angle-Side) criterion applies.

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      RHS does not apply here because the hypotenuses (PR and SQ) are not given as equal initially.

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is ∆PQR ≅ ∆SRQ by SAS.

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ∠PQR = 90°

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ∠SRQ = 90°

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      PQ = SR

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\nदिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      बिंदु P और S रेखाखंड QR के एक ही तरफ हैं,

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      \\(\\angle PQR = 90^{\\circ}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      \\(\\angle SRQ = 90^{\\circ}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      \\(PQ = SR\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      एक समकोण और समान आसन्न भुजाओं वाले दो त्रिभुजों के विन्यास में, हम SAS (भुजा-कोण-भुजा) सर्वांगसमता मानदंड का उपयोग कर सकते हैं।

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      गणनाएँ:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      चूँकि \\(PQ = SR\\), \\(\\angle PQR = \\angle SRQ = 90^{\\circ}\\), और दोनों त्रिभुजों में भुजा QR उभयनिष्ठ है:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ \\(\\triangle PQR \\cong \\triangle SRQ\\) (SAS सर्वांगसमता मानदंड द्वारा)

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ सही उत्तर विकल्प (4) अर्थात ∆PQR ≅ ∆SRQ  SAS  द्वारा है। 

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n159:T673,

                                                                                                                                                                                      ఇవ్వబడింది:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      \\(\\angle PQR = 90^{\\circ}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      \\(\\angle SRQ = 90^{\\circ}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      \\(PQ = SR\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      లంబకోణం మరియు సమాన అనుబంధ భుజాలతో రెండు త్రిభుజాలతో కూడిన కాన్ఫిగరేషన్‌లో, మనం SAS (భుజం-కోణం-భుజం) సర్వసమానత ప్రమాణాన్ని ఉపయోగించవచ్చు.

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      कारण \\(PQ = SR\\) , \\(\\angle PQR = \\angle SRQ = 90^{\\circ}\\) , आणि दोन्ही त्रिकोण बाजू QR शेअर करतात:

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                      We can use the successive percentage change formula: Net Change % = a + b + (a × b) ÷ 100

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is 14.32%.
